executedChecks.scope: 24 guards were removed one at a time and the module tests failed every time: blind-annotator, rubric drift, adjudicator independence at creation and at use, duplicate annotator, multiple adjudications, two-annotator minimum, disagreement detection, adjudication completeness, label and commitment binding, exact observed-write commitment, outputs only on completion, uncommitted-output refusal, unit-derived holdout seal, deterministic-oracle exact type, record shape, case-insensitive and key-scanning leak check, label cap, provenance check, abstention exclusion from adjudication, oracle not-used status, proxy countsAsCorrectness. One initial survivor (the proxy label flag) led to an added assertion and was then killed.

limits: Pure offline engineering controls on synthetic units with deterministic doubles. No host, model, native session, paid route, file, clock or network access; time is a caller-supplied integer tick. Oracles are exact-type fixture-correctness and serial-reference checks reusing the SPEC-048 OutcomeVerifier/VerifierRequest handoff; the serial oracle compares created/modified files only, not deletions. Records bind data by digest and consumers check exact shape, but human, proxy and adjudication records are self-asserted: authenticity of annotator, adjudicator or model identity and actual blinding are not verified. The leak check refuses held-out grader bytes and identity hashes (any case) in context keys and values only; encoded, paraphrased or summarized material is not detected, and material shorter than 16 bytes is matched only as a whole key or value. No human annotation was performed and no agreement statistic is computed; no utility, cohort or cost claim is made. Pre-PR reviews (code-review, code-review-and-quality, code-simplification) were run by Claude subagents and are not independent Luna review.
outcome: Only committed outputs equal to the observed writes are graded; candidate-supplied acceptance files do not change oracle verdicts; oracle, blinded human and proxy results are kept in separate sections with no blended verdict; human disagreement stays unresolved without a complete independent adjudication record; abstentions, insufficient annotators, failed attempts and inconclusive oracles are recorded as missing labels; held-out records and held-out grader material are refused before selection or solver context.
